title: Calibration version
description: One versioned calibration snapshot with lineage (AES-V2.10 / SUE-568). Never the mean of all feedback ever recorded — see docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §6-§7. status "candidate" is the DRIFT_CANDIDATE an agent may raise (write-authority class 3, automatic); status "active"/"superseded" require a human authorized_by (class 4, explicit human intent) — enforced by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs, not merely by this schema. Historical records are immutable evidence: superseding a version writes a NEW file and sets superseded_by on the old one; it never edits the old version's substantive fields. See calibration/CALIBRATION-PROTOCOL.md.

status.description: active: the currently authoritative snapshot for this scope. superseded: retained as immutable evidence, no longer authoritative. candidate: a DRIFT_CANDIDATE — recorded, never self-activating.

effective_from.description: When this version became (or would become) the active snapshot for its scope. Meaningless for status candidate until promoted.

supersedes.description: The calibration_id this version replaces, or null for the first version of a scope.

superseded_by.description: The calibration_id that replaced this one, or null while this version is still active/candidate. Set on the OLD file when a new one supersedes it — the old file's other fields never change.

signals.description: The four V2 signals (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §6). Kept structurally separate and never averaged: a change in owner_preference must not touch objective_quality or audience_fit history.

evidence_refs.description: Feedback / L1 review / real-output-corpus record ids that motivated this snapshot. scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs cross-checks these resolve and, for calibration_candidate-sourced evidence, that basis is explicit_human_feedback where required.

conflicting_evidence.description: Required (non-empty) when status is candidate: the independent explicit-human-feedback records that conflict with the currently active calibration for this scope. A model_inference-basis record may never serve as drift evidence — checked by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs against the referenced feedback records, not by this schema.

promotion.description: Present only when this active version was promoted from a candidate (DRIFT_CANDIDATE). Mirrors schemas/reference-evaluation.schema.json's promotion block rather than inventing a second shape. authorized_by here must be human — an agent may never activate a candidate it raised.

authorized_by.description: Must be a human identity (e.g. "human:owner") — checked by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs, not this schema, so the specific promotion-not-human code (rather than a generic schema failure) is reported.

basis.description: Why this promotion is justified: repeated independent evidence, or an explicit owner declaration that preference itself changed. "published" or "L1 pass" alone is never sufficient (mirrors reference-evaluation.schema.json).

evidence_refs.description: Must be non-empty and, unless basis states an explicit owner declaration, must carry more than one independent record — checked by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs.

scope.description: Which profile/modality/axis this calibration governs. Never the whole system at once.

profile_ref.description: Repository path of the profile this scope governs, when it governs one specific profile.

axis.description: The concrete axis this calibration governs, e.g. "audience.beginner-learner", "content.register", "brand_profile.suengj-com". Free text because the axis vocabulary is owned by editorial/profiles/**, not restated here.

type.description: human is required for status active/superseded — an agent may never author an active calibration version. Enforced by scripts/lib/calibration-core.mjs.

agent.description: Present only when type is "agent" (i.e. only legal on a candidate).
